saints.name: St. Wolfgang
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: A monk and reforming bishop of Regensburg who tutored a future emperor and served the poor…
biography: Born in Swabia about 934 and educated at the abbey of Reichenau, Wolfgang taught in the cathedral school of Trier before becoming a Benedictine monk. In 972 he was made bishop of Regensburg in Bavaria, where he reformed the monasteries, restored discipline among the clergy, and cared generously for the poor.

He served for a time as tutor to the young Henry, later the emperor St. Henry II. Renowned for learning, austerity, and preaching, he died in 994 while traveling and was buried at Regensburg. He was canonized in 1052 and became one of the most popular saints of medieval Germany.
saints.knownFor: Reforming his diocese and tutoring an emperor.
